claim_text: JPMorgan Chase says outside vendors that provide it services were the target of a cyberattack
summary: JPMorgan Chase said on Nov 19 that 'third parties who provide services to the firm were the target of a cyber attack', and that attackers accessed marketing data held by them, which may include some customer names and emails.
detail: JPMorgan Chase did not say when the attack happened, name the vendors or say how many customers were involved.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Reuters and ABC News each quote the same statement from a JPMorgan Chase spokesperson or the company, and BleepingComputer quotes the company's announcement.
notes: The company posted its statement on a social platform; we cite the outlets that reported it.

claim_text: Visa says the claims about its data come from an incident at a third-party service provider in Asia Pacific
summary: A Visa spokesperson said Visa is aware of the claims and that they are 'associated with an incident involving a third-party service provider in Asia Pacific.'
detail: ABC News says Visa said earlier the same week that it was aware one of its providers had a data breach.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Reuters, ABC News and BleepingComputer each quote the same Visa statement; BleepingComputer says it was given to it directly.

claim_text: Visa says its own systems were not involved and no card numbers were affected
summary: Visa says its systems 'were not involved and were not impacted' and that 'no payments data such as card numbers were affected.'
detail: BleepingComputer quotes Visa adding that this is unrelated to other system disruptions in the same week.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Visa's own word, repeated by three outlets. No one outside the company has checked it, so Reported.

claim_text: Mastercard says a third-party provider had an incident that exposed some cardholders' email addresses
summary: Mastercard says it was 'recently informed of an incident at a third-party provider' that exposed a 'limited amount of email addresses' of a small subset of cardholders enrolled in a specific benefit program.
detail: Mastercard did not name the provider or the benefit program.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Reuters, ABC News and BleepingComputer each quote the same Mastercard statement; BleepingComputer says it was given to it directly.

claim_text: Mastercard says its payment network was not affected and the exposure has been contained
summary: Mastercard says 'there is no impact to the Mastercard payment network or the ability for people to use their cards', that the exposure has been contained, and that it is working with the provider to support the cardholders affected.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Mastercard's own word, repeated by three outlets. No one outside the company has checked it, so Reported.

claim_text: JPMorgan Chase says the vendor attack is not connected to the bank's service disruption earlier that week
summary: JPMorgan Chase says there is 'no connection' between the vendor attack and the service disruption some of its customers had earlier in the week, and that its services were not disrupted by the attack.
detail: Reuters and ABC News report that the earlier disruption, which also slowed other banks, was put down to a software bug.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company's own statement, repeated by three outlets. No one outside the company has checked it, so Reported.

claim_text: JPMorgan Chase says it will contact affected customers directly
summary: JPMorgan Chase says it will contact affected customers directly; ABC News quotes it adding that, where appropriate, it will offer support including complimentary credit monitoring.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Reuters and ABC News each report the company's statement that it will contact affected customers.
notes: Credit monitoring is in the statement as quoted by ABC News.

claim_text: A group calling itself n0n claimed on Nov 16 to have data on JPMorgan Chase customers and posted similar claims about Visa and Mastercard
summary: Reuters reports that a cyber extortion group called n0n claimed on Nov 16 to have JPMorgan Chase cardmember records, and posted similar claims about Visa and Mastercard. BleepingComputer says it posted the data that day.
detail: This is the group's claim. None of the three companies has said the group was behind the vendor attacks. We did not open the group's site.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Two outlets report the group's own claim; the claim itself is not confirmed.

claim_text: Data Reuters reviewed held more than 16,000 customer email addresses and about 124 bank staff email addresses
summary: Reuters says the posted JPMorgan Chase data appears to include 124 bank staff email addresses and over 16,000 customer email addresses, some with phone numbers and postal codes. Reuters could not verify it.
detail: Reuters says the Visa data appears to cover Asia-Pacific markets and the Mastercard data customers in North America, the Middle East and Africa. JPMorgan Chase declined to comment on the data.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet's own review of the posted data. Not verified by Reuters or confirmed by any of the companies.

claim_text: Which vendor was attacked has not been confirmed
summary: None of the three companies has named the vendor. BleepingComputer reports that Qubole, a cloud data analytics company, is suspected, after n0n claimed an attack on it on Nov 11; Qubole had not replied.
detail: BleepingComputer does not say who suspects Qubole. No company has confirmed it. The same group also claims data from Expedia and Samsung Ads, which this site covers separately; no source ties those vendor incidents to this one.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the sources names the vendor as fact; BleepingComputer reports a suspicion that has not been confirmed.

claim_text: When the vendor attack happened is not known
summary: ABC News says JPMorgan Chase did not disclose when the cyberattack occurred. Visa and Mastercard did not give a date either.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the statements gives a date for the attack.

claim_text: How many customers were affected is not known
summary: None of the three companies has said how many customers were affected. Mastercard speaks of 'a small subset of cardholders' and JPMorgan Chase of 'some customer names and email addresses'.
detail: The 16,000 figure comes from Reuters' review of the group's posted data and has not been confirmed by any company.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: No source gives a confirmed count.

claim_text: JPMorgan Chase says its Chase brand helps 80 million individuals, families and businesses
summary: JPMorgan Chase's own about page says its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands serve millions of consumers, businesses and institutions, and that Chase helps '80 million individuals, families and businesses' through banking, saving and investing.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own page states it.
